mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-crisis recovery phases, a CPIAUCSL increase above 2.0% annually signals inflationary pressures that trigger Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of post-crisis periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units in a 3-month average, it signals weak residential demand that reduces overall economic activity and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) combined with a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
